properties.name: Orbit Track Generation v1
properties.description: Generates a predicted ground-track product for one full orbital period (~100 minutes) by propagating SGP4 positions at 60-second intervals from the current epoch forward. Each track product is an array of {lat_deg, lon_deg, alt_km, timestamp} points. Product is regenerated every 5 minutes to incorporate any TLE updates. Reference implementation: python-sgp4 (Brandon Rhodes).
